extracts.description: The account number of the newly opened SAVINGS account

finish.name: Open New Savings Account
finish.description: Logs into ParaBank with a username (input) and password (secret), navigates to Open New Account, selects the SAVINGS account type (funded from the customer's existing default source account), submits the request, and extracts the newly created account number as output "newAccountNumber". This action is irreversible (it opens a real account and may transfer a minimum $90 funding deposit) and requires human approval on replay. No alternate business outcomes (e.g. insufficient funds) were observed during this flow since the destination/source account combo defaulted successfully; if the source account lacks sufficient funds ParaBank may reject the request — this was not encountered here and would need separate handling if seen.
finish.summary: Logged into ParaBank as an existing customer, opened the "Open New Account" page, selected account type SAVINGS (funding from default account 20781), submitted the request, and confirmed success via the "Account Opened!" confirmation page. Extracted the new account number (21003) as the capability's output.
